purpose: Five new mobile directions superseding the desktop assumption; no app build
common:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create one realistic, meticulously art-directed high-fidelity ANDROID MUSIC APP screenshot for a personal Navidrome client. This is one visual design direction, not implementation.
Target logical viewport 390 x 844; render a crisp high-resolution raster around 780 x 1688 (same portrait ratio). App content only, edge-to-edge rectangular canvas: no phone/device/bezel, notch, Dynamic Island, OS status bar, battery/time, home indicator, browser, surrounding desktop, presentation frame, collage, watermark, external concept title or option number. Date anchor 15 October 2026; do not add dates.
Attached reference images show music UX patterns from iOS apps. Reinterpret those patterns for Android using a normal Android back arrow, generous approximately 48dp hit targets and a bottom navigation bar with labels. Do not copy Apple system UI, reference brand logos, exact artwork, watermarks, commercial features or exact layouts. Create an original visual system.
Screen: the user's own playlist "Onderweg", 36 tracks, fully downloaded. All five concepts show this SAME playlist task for comparison. Dutch interface. A clearly readable "Mp3 toevoegen" affordance with upload icon belongs in the top app bar; it is an access point to a separately designed future import flow, not an open upload form. Album/playlist metadata must stay sparse: "36 nummers" and a checkmark with exact text "Offline beschikbaar". No fake storage numbers, total playlist duration or match percentages.
Use an original photographic playlist cover of a winding coastal road at sunset with warm apricot sky, deep blue water and a small golden sun; compose it naturally to the chosen slot. This is generated fictional playlist artwork, no lettering. Original track artwork can include warm window-shadow photography and blue ocean images.
Primary listening controls: distinct "Shuffle" and "Mix op klank" choices with Mix op klank selected; one clear pause icon for currently playing. Use two readable choice pills and a 56dp circle pause action if that fits, or an equally clear uncluttered arrangement. Absolutely never pair a pause icon with the label Afspelen. Do not show every supported feature, sliders, analytics or technical plugin names.
Track rows, in this order: Window Seat — Mara Vale (current playing); After Rain — Mara Vale; Blue Hours — Luca North; Paper Skies — Mara Vale. Compact directions may additionally show Low Sun — Mara Vale and Still Here — Mara Vale. Use cover thumbnails, a two-line title/artist, a small offline-ready check and overflow action. No need for track durations; prioritize readable hierarchy. Clearly mark Window Seat playing, not a second selected song.
One persistent mini-player above bottom navigation: Window Seat, Mara Vale, small artwork, pause icon and queue access. This and the page pause act on the same current playback. Do not add a second full player or duplicated navigation. Bottom nav: "Bibliotheek", "Zoeken", "Offline"; Bibliotheek selected. Android style, not an iPhone dock.
Design a focused primary screen with purposeful space, strong typography, sharp icons and excellent contrast. Body text around 14-16sp at logical viewport, secondary around 12-14sp, max two font families. Use grouping, spacing and fine row separators before borders/cards. No cards inside cards, empty placeholders, emoji, glass bubbles, generic AI-dashboard styling or random gradients. A normal track list is one grouped surface. Fit every visible row and player completely, nothing clipped or overlapped. More generous designs show four track rows; compact designs may show six. Remove decoration before reducing legibility. The result must look like a polished everyday Android music app, not a concept poster or a marketing webpage.

concepts.title: Obsidiaan
concepts.brief: Direction: a luxurious dark playlist experience with a cinematic art-led hierarchy. Nearly-black warm charcoal #12100f, ivory text, muted copper #d88a58 as the sole interface accent. Four visible tracks. A generous wide crop of the sunset-road cover occupies the top part of the content, subtly fading only at its bottom into the base surface, with the bold confident 42sp title Onderweg anchored beneath or naturally over the darker area. It must still feel like useful product UI. Small metadata and offline-ready check; bold copper selected Mix op klank control and restrained outlined Shuffle control, round ivory pause. The artwork and title are the visual lead; keep the lower track list clean, close and consistent. A low dark mini-player with clear divider and an understated bottom navigation. Font system: contemporary grotesk with slightly condensed confident headline, readable regular UI. No neon, bloom, fake soundwave or excessive gradients. Top Mp3 toevoegen action remains legible and reachable. Distinctive warm night-listening mood, no clutter and no oversized empty areas.

concepts.title: Papier
concepts.brief: Direction: an elegant editorial music journal translated into a highly usable Android app. Warm ivory #f5f0e8, near-black ink, vermilion #b7412d accents. Distinctive expressive serif playlist title resembling Fraunces around 44sp; crisp restrained sans-serif UI. Avoid a big streaming-service banner: use a smaller square sunset-road artwork around 100dp offset beside or below the title in an asymmetric but rigorously aligned header block. Let the playlist and typography breathe. Six well-spaced visible track rows with simple hairline separators, artwork around 36-40dp, no boxed cards. The active track gets a fine vermilion indicator and clear weight/color. The selected Mix op klank pill is warm red, Shuffle is understated, pause round ink or red with correct contrast. Flat ivory mini-player and bottom nav with a thin top divider, no floating Apple dock. Small upload affordance in app bar. Refined print-catalogue character with enough density for a large music library. Not sepia vintage hardware, not hand-drawn stationery, not a marketing landing page.

concepts.title: Volt
concepts.brief: Direction: confident, expressive contemporary Android design with a fresh graphic identity. Light ice-blue #edf4ff page, deep cobalt #1b4ce0 typography/selected controls, one controlled acid-lime #dcf26a pause action, dark navy body copy. Rounded but disciplined Android shapes, not generic iOS glass. Strong modern sans-serif and a bold 40sp title. Four visible track rows. Header uses a playful but balanced asymmetric arrangement: an approximately 125dp square original coastal-road cover offset beside the large playlist title and sparse 36 nummers/offline status, all aligned to a precise grid. A vibrant cobalt selected Mix op klank pill and quiet Shuffle, large easy lime pause circle. Allow one shaped soft-blue supporting surface for the mini-player or header only; track rows remain an open list, never separate bubble cards. Thoughtful large tap targets and useful whitespace. Bottom nav uses simple icon/label items with a restrained selected capsule. Mp3 toevoegen is visible at top, without becoming the main call to action. This should look desirable and energetic while staying readable and calm; no purple gradients, mascot, stickers, confetti or arbitrary geometric decoration.

concepts.title: Raster
concepts.brief: Direction: an exceptionally precise, compact Android playlist browser for a collector with a large library. Blue-graphite #17212a background, near-white text, icy cyan #8edbe4 active accents. Typography resembling IBM Plex Sans with monospaced tiny metadata only, never a coding terminal. Compact 80dp square playlist artwork beside a 32sp Onderweg heading and clear offline status, leaving more room for SIX complete track rows at comfortable roughly 56dp height. Clear structured alignment, simple fine separators, small 36dp thumbnails, bright current-track marker and no large hero or giant headline. Keep Shuffle and Mix op klank separate, the active mode subtly cyan filled, and a properly scaled circle pause. Main controls remain at least 48dp touch height. Top app bar has Android back and Mp3 toevoegen, useful hierarchy not tiny icons. Footer mini-player is part of the dark base with precise edge alignment; bottom nav has readable labels. This is quietly technical, fast and elegant, not a developer/admin dashboard, file manager, literal terminal or cramped tiny-text spreadsheet. No excessive outlined containers or rounded cards. Distinguish it structurally from the cinematic direction through compact header and more visible songs.

concepts.title: Mos
concepts.brief: Direction: a beautifully restrained, airy Android music app with a natural gallery-like identity. Pale sage #e8eee6, deep forest #24493e text and controls, soft warm white secondary surfaces. Humanist sans-serif, harmonious medium weights, no serif. Four complete track rows. The coastal-road cover becomes a distinct generous landscape artwork strip below the top bar, naturally cropped without distortion, around 135dp tall. Below it a simple left-aligned 36sp Onderweg title with sparse metadata and quiet green offline-ready check, then disciplined listening controls. Dark forest selected Mix op klank, understated Shuffle, round forest pause. Fine separators and spacious text; artwork thumbnails muted but real, current track indicated with a small forest-green sound mark. The mini-player can be a single low warm-white surface with a restrained subtle corner radius; avoid stacking many panels. Bottom nav integrated into the page, no floating translucent dock. Mp3 toevoegen remains a visible clear text action at the top. The feeling is contemporary, fresh and mature, like an independent nature photography publication built for daily listening; not boho crafts, textured paper UI, spa advertising or a beige dashboard.
